Search Veteran Employment Opportunities at CDC Top of Page Scientific Research is in CDC's DNA Join our team and apply science to solve important health problems. Love Lab Work? Conduct critical science at CDC and help protect our nation against dangerous health threats. USPHS Commissioned Corps Join the thousands of highly qualified public health professionals as part of the U.S. Public Health Service Corps. Overseen by the surgeon general, you will be part of an elite and diverse team of professionals essential to public health leadership and exemplary clinical service. Learn More Working at CDC Whether your background is in medicine, health care, research, or operations, you can help fight diseases and epidemics to make our nation, and the world, a better place for all to live and thrive. Saving lives and protecting people around the world—that’s what CDC is all about.
